attempt_summaries.rationale: Added automountServiceAccountToken false, securityContext with runAsNonRoot true, runAsUser 999, allowPrivilegeEscalation false, readOnlyRootFilesystem true, and resource limits/requests (memory >=128Mi).

final_yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: cache
  namespace: shop
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: cache
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: cache
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      containers:
        - name: redis
          image: redis:7.4.1
          args: ["--save", "", "--appendonly", "no", "--maxmemory", "100mb"]
          ports:
            - containerPort: 6379
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /data
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 999
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          resources:
            limits:
              memory: 128Mi
              cpu: 250m
            requests:
              memory: 64Mi
              cpu: 100m
      volumes:
        - name: data
          emptyDir: {}
